title: She only comes once every 76 years ☄️
caption:
Next time: 2061. Will you still be here? ☄️
Tag who you're watching it with 👇
first_comment: How old will you be in 2061? 👇
sources: NASA Science, 'Comet 1P/Halley' (about 76-year orbit, nucleus about 15 x 8 km, last perihelion 1986, next 2061; parent of the Eta Aquariid and Orionid meteor showers)
Paine A. B. (1912) 'Mark Twain: A Biography' (the 'I came in with Halley's comet' quote); Twain born 30 Nov 1835, died 21 Apr 1910, perihelion 20 Apr 1910
